label: Gunk, atomicity and physical composition
resolution: Every object has a strict nonempty proper part is stronger than merely failure of all-object atomicity in a mixed domain. Minimal parts (atomicity), fusion of atoms (atomisticity), and terminating decomposition are distinct. Regular open regions form a mathematical carrier: individual points are not objects, joins regularize unions, and remainders collect all disjoint parts rather than every point in a raw set difference. Exact remainder/fusion consistency establishes no physical gunk or actual material universalism. Removing Boolean zero does not alone exclude a least remaining element in every Boolean algebra.
